title: 第12章 女鬼现身-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》
content:
第(1/3)页

    吴姜走进了房间，目光快速扫过一圈，除了扑面而来的浓郁阴气，就没有其他发现异常发现了。

    房间很大，一张宽大的双人床摆在房间中央，床上躺着一个二十来岁的年轻人，眉眼清秀，却面色苍白如纸，眉头紧紧皱着，呼吸微弱，显然睡得极不安稳，偶尔还会发出一两声低低的呓语，像是在做什么噩梦。

    吴姜凝神打量着躺着的年轻人，阴阳眼一看，顿时心中有数了。

    这小子的阳气已经损耗大半，周身萦绕着淡淡的阴气，显然被缠了不短时间。

    他又顺手拉开房间里的衣柜、床头柜，翻找了一圈，连女鬼的一丝影子都没瞧见，心里满是疑惑：现在也不是白天，阳气不盛，这女鬼到底躲哪儿去了？

    实在找不到头绪，吴姜也只能暂时放弃，无奈地转身下了楼。

    “小姜，怎么样了？”

    看到吴姜下来，王老板的夫人第一个忍不住迎了上去，语气里满是急切与忐忑。

    她就这么一个宝贝儿子，这段时间被闹鬼的事折腾得心力交瘁，整个人都憔悴了一圈，眼底的红血丝清晰可见。

    王老板也紧随其后，眼神里带着一丝不易察觉的期盼，紧紧盯着吴姜。虽说他心里对吴姜的年纪仍有怀疑，可事到如今，但凡有一丝希望，他都不愿放过。

    吴姜先轻轻摇了摇头，才缓缓开口回应：“阿姨，王叔叔，我没找到那鬼的踪迹，不知道他（她）藏到哪儿去了，现在只能等她主动现身。”

    听到这话，王老板夫妇脸上的期盼瞬间褪去，取而代之的是难以掩饰的失望。

    吴姜见状，连忙开口追问：“王叔叔，阿姨，你们先跟我说说，那鬼平时一般什么时候出来？还有你们之前请的那些人，都是怎么对付她的？”
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

Wu Jiang walked into the room and quickly glanced around. Apart from the strong Yin Qi that hit his face, he found nothing unusual.

The room was very large. A large double bed was placed in the center of the room. Lying on the bed was a young man in his twenties, with handsome features but a pale face. His brows were tightly knitted and his breathing was weak. It was obvious that he was sleeping very uneasily. Occasionally, he would utter one or two low murmurs, as if he was having a nightmare.

Wu Jiang looked at the young man lying down intently, and when he saw it with his yin and yang eyes, he immediately knew what was going on.

Most of this boy's yang energy has been lost, and there is a faint yin energy lingering around him. It is obvious that he has been entangled for a long time.

He opened the wardrobe and bedside table in the room and rummaged around, but didn't see even a trace of the female ghost. He was full of doubts: It was not daytime and the yang energy was not strong. Where on earth was this female ghost hiding?

Really unable to find a clue, Wu Jiang could only give up temporarily and turned around helplessly and went downstairs.

"Xiao Jiang, how are you?"

Seeing Wu Jiang coming down, Boss Wang’s wife could not help but greet him first, her tone full of eagerness and anxiety.

She is just such a precious son. During this period of time, she was so exhausted mentally and physically by the hauntings. She looked haggard, and the red bloodshot eyes were clearly visible.

Boss Wang followed closely behind, staring closely at Wu Jiang with a hint of unnoticeable expectation in his eyes.Although he still had doubts about Wu Jiang's age, at this point, he was unwilling to let go of any glimmer of hope.

Wu Jiang shook his head gently first, and then slowly responded: "Auntie, Uncle Wang, I can't find any trace of the ghost. I don't know where he (she) is hiding. Now I can only wait for her to show up."

Hearing this, the expectation on the faces of Mr. Wang and his wife instantly faded away, replaced by unconcealable disappointment.

Seeing this, Wu Jiang quickly asked: "Uncle Wang, Auntie, tell me first, when does the ghost usually come out? And how did those people you invited before deal with her?"
